documents.title: UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED ON 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Intimation for CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30TH SEPTEMBER 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm reported a robust financial performance for fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to 3,188 lakhs and gross sales reaching 34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes, supported by enhanced capacity utilization and strategic cost management. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park in Tamil Nadu, commenced logistics and trading activities there, and placed orders for new machinery. Additionally, management recommended a 15% dividend of Rs. 0.15 per equity share for the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company maintained a focus on high-demand, high-profitability product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for the manufacture of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machines.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The company procured raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable finished goods selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit was achieved because the company arranged raw materials at cheaper rates without changing finished goods sale prices.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: Production of finished goods items that were not generating good profits was stopped.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: Increased production volume resulted from enhanced capacity utilization after commissioning new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: This increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year, which has strengthened our manufacturing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 metric tonnes of PVC flooring, sheetings, and films during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher capacity utilization was achieved with the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The Board transferred an amount of Rs. 400 Lakh to General Reserves during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.75 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2024 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the restructuring of the share capital by sub-dividing existing equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received an NSE penalty notice for a delay in uploading the Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9).
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to an economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The re-appointment of Shri Ram Babu Verma as Executive Director was approved for 12 months starting from December 27, 2025 to December 26, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Company for 12 months from 27 th , 2025 to 26December th , 2026December

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
